foot_corollary: A flight starting from a floor whose first riser line lies inside a member billed through the junction at full section (a beam band at that floor, a ground beam) is deducted by its solid below the floor level inside that member: for a straight flight with the first riser line a metres inside the band face, V = (d a - k a^2 / 2) w, d = t / cos(pitch), k = riser / going, while a <= d / k. The step triangles stand above the floor and are never deducted. If the foot lies on a member billed by NO line (an unbilled shaft floor, a ground beam reported only as an exposure), the stair keeps it and the junction is listed UNDETERMINED with its bound.
head_on_ground_corollary: The arrival wedge of a flight whose last riser line rises onto a ground slab / ground beam (no landing modelled) is owned by the member whose billed solid contains it (slab: Q-62 A cond; ground beam: R-CONC-OWN-1), part by part; the rest stays in the stair.
column_corollary: A column whose billed line runs the full storey interval through a flight or landing owns the intersection (precedence COLUMN > STAIR); while no column line bills it (columns blocked, or the scheduled section's position not established), the stair keeps it and the junction is UNDETERMINED with its bound (drawn section).
knee_rule: Owner manual method and drawing-derived method are kept side by side: the owner's Q-47 A waist stops at the first and the last riser line (plumb cuts). The drawing-derived solid (i) ADDS the top knee where a flight arrives into a landing or a plate from below: the solid between the waist-soffit line produced and the landing soffit beyond the last riser line, V = 1/2 (s_top - L) (H - t_L - (k L - d)) w, s_top = (H - t_L + d) / k; (ii) REMOVES the bottom knee where a flight leaves a landing upward: V = 1/2 s_b (d - t_L) w, s_b = (d - t_L) / k, when d > t_L. Neither is silently added to the owner-method quantity; both are reported as DRAWING-DERIVED with their source, for the owner's information. A head or foot inside a full-depth beam has no knee (the beam face bounds the soffit).
landing_rule: A floor-arrival landing inside a floor-slab panel is slab (and beam) concrete only; an intermediate landing is stair concrete; a landing poured with a slab panel that bills it (same level, inside the panel outline) is never counted in the stair (R-STAIR-LAND-1, T-184).
formwork_corollary: Formwork follows the same boundary as the concrete: no soffit form over the part of a waist inside a full-depth member; the vertical face above the last tread at a band face is ONE face (counted once, as the stair riser or as the beam side, never both).
